name: Xingyun Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Xingyun Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the cross-border e-commerce business in China and internationally. The company offers export and domestic trade services for beauty products, maternal and infant products, cosmetics, food and health products, home and outdoor products, 3C electronics, home appliances, and pet supplies through agents and e-commerce platforms; brand marketing; and software system design, development, consulting, and maintenance services.
